title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Solar PV Panel Fault Classification
mechanism: Fuses a JEPA-pretrained ViT with an EfficientNetV2-S branch for thermal fault classification.
evidence: R: PVF-10 10-class F1 93.21, acc 94.33; ISM 12-class F1 72.60, acc 83.88; binary F1 97.53 / 94.69; 108.6 M params.
adaptation: Strong ready baseline for the thermal deliverable; not expected to help EL (frozen foundation features were n.d. on EL).
min_experiment: Run official code on PVF-10 fixed split, then test on A3 as in the PVF-10 experiment; keep it over ResNet-34 only if > 2 F1 points better cross-plant.
prior_overlap: none for thermal; foundation encoders on EL closed only for frozen probes and one ConvNeXt-T screen.
